changes: Inlined the shared history algorithm and request hook into one import-free middleware file.
No model detection, guard, dashboard, proxy service or provider configuration is included.
Version 0.1.1 adds history/portable-web-search.mjs, inlined into the middleware to convert historical native web_search_call items to labeled text after reasoning is removed.
Version 0.1.2 exports onProvider: a request through a Magpie group or fallback is filtered on each provider try with the tried provider's rule. onRequest and onProvider are the only exports.

The files above are byte-identical to the pinned commit in the source repository. derivedFrom names the original baseline; that commit is no longer on a branch or tag since the source repository's public history was rebuilt.
